owner_decision.statement: The Owner explicitly directed implementation and final publication of STYNX 1.6.0, normal protected integration, DETRAN adoption and continued audit remediation under ADR-DEVAI-ADOPTION-0019. This prospective registry binding replaces the completed 1.5.7 target; it does not assert 1.6.0 publication, certification or product acceptance. Authenticated metadata census at 2026-10-10T23:37:48.212Z, SHA-256 97757a0f0a859cab3701edb2fc4c27ff0a0fc872d0046c3aae2c20d9abde2385, contains the exact 44-package roster: latest is 1.5.7 for all 44, rc remains 1.5.0-rc.2, and 1.6.0 is absent for all 44; complete authenticated GitHub inventory agrees. The census lists angular-profile 2.0.0 but contains no fresh anomaly tarball/integrity proof. A separate read-only authenticated artifact download and GitHub version-identity verification at 2026-10-10T23:48:39.816Z, report SHA-256 95d548ba88620db98c7f52f44591fd32ad301b4fd74e5a821f43a8d1aa5f1dd2, confirms the original 25,172-byte artifact SHA-256 7cefacd0535d0f5e7398a8a5d1e44d29415dd4aa234269d36eb28c97f25b7aee, recorded npm integrity and GitHub package version ID 1024692931 unchanged; no registry mutation was performed. Its recorded identity, permissions and immutable history are preserved; a fresh exact-main preflight remains required before publication. Publish only latest after ordinary product/release gates, signed exact-candidate RC and independent hardening, a fresh exact-main census and the action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt faithfully bound to the existing mandate. Preflight latest must remain 1.5.7 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. The accepted feature-publication exception concerns only rolling CI history; the actual publication-time scorecard must be disclosed and subsequent remediation continued. Tests, thresholds, substantive gates, historical 1.5.7 observation bytes/proof-chain prefix and readiness_promoting=false remain unchanged. Stop at the first failed, partial or ambiguous publication; recovery requires fresh exact Owner authorization. This decision authorizes no deletion, deprecation, replacement or dist-tag mutation of angular-profile 2.0.0. Historical 1.5.7 decision (preserved verbatim): The Owner retained the no-migration 1.5.6 and migration-bearing 1.5.7 split on 2026-10-10 and subsequently directed proceeding until complete 1.5.7 final publication, superseding the earlier holds. Stable 1.5.6 is independently verified for all 44 fixed-group packages from main 6dabf052b2948fe0c2688cdb23c9d390c16af5ed, tree 9102e545c8c09b2ea4cf694cef1abea221a686e9, publication run 38028077567 and annotated unified v1.5.6 tag ed3dbc41d0b3a89b18f8f642efc5ddd77597a0df. Fresh authenticated census at 2026-10-10T05:58:39.542Z observed all 44 latest tags at 1.5.6, rc 1.5.0-rc.2 unchanged, 1.5.7 absent for all packages, matching published 1.5.6 integrities and the unchanged angular-profile 2.0.0 integrity; report SHA-256 9d35cc4c4a8719a5773ed72b8c3fff2b9072990567317de00889f39716fb2822. Exactly the outbox-configurable-app-role and offline-sync-1-5-7-pending-review-context changesets advance the fixed group to 1.5.7 under ADR-DEVAI-ADOPTION-0018 for UPS-OBX-10 and UPS-OFS-06/07/08. The 1.5.6 observation SC-20261010T050509-001 is RED and non-promoting; its real readings, proof chain and evidence remain preserved. Publish only with latest and an action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt under the existing mandate, after ordinary gates and a fresh exact-main census. Preflight latest must remain 1.5.6 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. Stop at the first failed, partial or ambiguous publication; recovery requires fresh Owner authorization. This decision does not authorize angular-profile 2.0.0 remediation.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
